concept: One night-sky world the viewer never leaves: a moon crosses it, Earth grows two water bulges under it, a pin rides Earth through both, and a gauge plus tide curve turn the ride into a number. The HUD route strip counts the beats; captions carry the voice.

narrativeArc.beginning: The Moon circles Earth and the oceans answer: two tides a day.
narrativeArc.middle: Why (two bulges), how you meet them (Earth spins under them), how long between (12.4 h).
narrativeArc.end: Three cards compress it; the Moon sets the clock.
narrativeArc.viewerTakeaway: Two bulges, a spinning Earth, so high tide returns about every 12.4 hours.

typography.hierarchy: heading 110-150 / readout value 60 / caption 38 / panel note 28 / kicker 24; one gold focal value per beat
typography.pairingReason: Montserrat Black gives headline weight on a dark sky; Poppins keeps long labels legible; JetBrains Mono makes changing numbers tabular and instrument-like.

designSystem.accentRule: Gold marks the ONE focal value per beat: the Moon's callout, the active caption word, the pin, the gauge needle and the interval value. Cold blue only marks the far-side bulge (the 'other' side), never a second accent.

background.treatment: world sky: gradient + directional light + 3 parallax cloud bands + drifting motes (MH.world.sky)
background.notes: same sky in every scene; panels and instruments sit ON it, never a different full-frame environment
background.justifyDark: Dark navy is the world: it is a deliberate night-sky setting with lit hero objects, not a void with floating text.

composition.grid: content in y 120-850; HUD top strip y 36-90 and route strip y ~1050; caption pill y 860-990
composition.alignment: split layouts: hero object one side, readout panel the other; off-centre
composition.safeAreas: action 90%, title 80%; check every panel at its largest state
composition.textDensity: max 10 words per panel; captions carry the narration

transitionLanguage.primary: cloud-bank pass: a cloud-coloured band sweeps across at each scene start
transitionLanguage.secondary: camera push on the 3D hero into the next object
transitionLanguage.rule: scene change always passes through the world's own cloud bank so the world feels continuous

pacing.rhythm: beats of 4-8 s, each with one hero object and one callout

illustration: Earth sphere, ocean bulge, moon, orbit path, CSS-3D stage, gauge, tide curve, three summary icons: all drawn in SVG/CSS

consistencyRules: Every scene sits on the same sky layer; no scene paints its own full-frame background.
Each beat has exactly one hero object and at most one gold focal value.
Scene changes always pass through the cloud-bank sweep centred on the boundary.
Panels are navy-light with an 8px gold (or cold) bar; no other card style.
Content stays in y 120-850; captions own y 860-990; HUD owns the top and bottom strips.
Numbers are JetBrains Mono; headings Montserrat Black; everything else Poppins.
antiPatterns: No scene that is only text on the sky (every beat needs its hero object)
No photographs, stock footage or a different full-frame environment per scene
No glow on objects: the only light is the single directional sun wash in the sky layer
No second accent colour; cold blue means far side only
No counting animation that overshoots the real value (12.4 h, 24.8 h)
No caption that outruns the narration: word timing comes from the transcript data
No visible grid or construction lines
referenceRules: Persistent world + HUD + captions are separate layer compositions mounted for the full duration under or over per-beat scenes.
